NACLO is held annually for US and Canadian high school students. It consists of two rounds:

- **Open Round** (January): Any student may participate. Problems range from accessible to challenging.
- **Invitational Round** (March): Top scorers from the Open are invited. Problems are harder, and top scorers advance to IOL.

## Problem difficulty at NACLO

NACLO problems are self-contained — no prior linguistics knowledge is required. The problems are designed so that a careful, methodical thinker can solve them purely from the data provided.

A typical Open Round has 6–8 problems of increasing difficulty. The Invitational has 5–6 harder problems plus a collaborative team component (NACLI).
